description: This is a C source file implementing a memory stress testing tool with multithreading, configurable memory allocation, hot memory maintenance, and performance measurement features.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Holds configuration parameters for memory stress test, including memory size, thread count, and behavior flags.

classes.name: Alloc_stats
classes.description: Tracks statistics for each thread, including allocated memory size and timing information.

methods.name: worker_thread
methods.description: Main function executed by each thread to allocate memory, optionally keep it hot, and report timing.

methods.name: read_config
methods.description: Parses command line arguments to set configuration parameters.

methods.name: create_threads
methods.description: Creates worker threads based on configuration.

methods.name: collect_threads
methods.description: Joins all worker threads after completion.

methods.name: print_results
methods.description: Outputs total memory allocated and throughput statistics.
